recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a woman in denim against a lush, sun-drenched garden backdrop, featuring a decorative graphic badge in the upper right corner that combines circular and rectangular frames with stylized floral accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm, golden backlighting contrasting with the cool blue of the denim fabric.
Soft-focus organic background foliage framing the sharp central subject.
Geometric graphic badge overlaying the naturalistic photographic scene.
Textured grain and high-key highlights typical of mid-70s film stock.
coreInvariants: Crossed-arm pose with a direct, neutral gaze.
Western-style denim shirt with visible stitching and embroidery.
Graphic badge containing two distinct typographic styles.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, woman occupying the vertical center of the frame from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast graphic badge in the top right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the crossed arms, then travels up to the decorative badge at the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft-focus greenery on the left and right, creating a sense of depth and airiness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm greens and yellows in the background providing a luminous glow.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone blue denim acting as the primary anchor for the subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (brown/tan) in the badge and belt, with small pops of red and yellow embroidery.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key values with soft, low-contrast shadows; saturation is naturalistic but leaning toward warm, golden hues.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Elongated swashes and decorative flourishes on terminals
Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters with extended, looping tails
Lowercase letters with rounded, bulbous counters

composition.position: Top right within a rectangular banner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, flourished display face paired with a simpler, path-aligned secondary face for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative serif feel with similar flourishes.
Matches the custom-lettered look of the primary display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, sun-drenched 1970s-style portrait of a woman with long feathered hair, wearing a blue denim shirt, arms crossed, standing in a bright green garden with golden backlighting and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a graphic badge in the top right corner consisting of a circular frame intersecting a horizontal tan banner. Inside the banner, place decorative swash-heavy serif lettering. Along the inner curve of the circle, place bold lowercase slab-serif text. Decorate the badge with fine-line black ink floral sketches.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and diffused?
Does the denim look authentic to the era?
Is the typography contained within the graphic badge?
Are there decorative flourishes on the main text?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the badge does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the text follows the circular path correctly.
Check that the film grain is consistent across the image.
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm/denim range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus 70s portrait with a structured, multi-frame graphic badge containing contrasting decorative and path-aligned typography.
